title: You and your school council
creator_credit: Victoria. Dept. of Education and Early Childhood Development, Mark Laughlin and Jeff Spencer
brief_description: Highlights the new roles and responsibilities of school councils. Emphasizes the participation of parents, students and teachers in school governance; and the importance of collaborative decision making in developing school policies and priorities. Encourages parents to become involved in school councils.
